description: Run a deterministic 20-test Cargo-style fixture through the real RTK rewrite and Codex PostToolUse hook, then report it in Caveman full style.
methodology: Counts all model-visible operation text: assistant response, command, RTK tool output, PostToolUse compact context, and optimizer notices. Excludes the user prompt, tool JSON framing, hidden reasoning, and the once-per-session SessionStart notice.

The passing cases cover access-token validation, refresh-token rotation, cache expiry, and the complete set of user creation, lookup, update, and rejection paths. There were no failed, ignored, measured, or filtered tests, and the run finished in 0.03 seconds, so the repository is ready for the next step.
